notes.title: Stolen Realm, Our First Hit, Receives Major Update + Chaos DLC on June 18
notes.content:
[h1]Stolen Realm (Turn Based RPG) — DLC + Free Major Update Incoming[/h1][p][/p][p]We know you're a fan of action roguelikes, but you might find a new thrill in testing your tactical thinking with [i]Stolen Realm[/i]—our turn-based tactical RPG that offers strategic depth and varied gameplay.[/p][p]Launching June 18th, the [i]Chaos Pack[/i] DLC introduces a brand-new Chaos Skill Tree featuring over 30 unique abilities. From conjuring random objects mid-battle to swapping places with allies—or even barrels—these skills offer a high-risk, high-reward playstyle that keeps every encounter exciting.

[/p][h3]🔥 Chaos Pack DLC – Unleash Mayhem[/h3][p]Unlock the brand-new Chaos Tree, featuring:

[/p][list][*][p] ⚔️ 30+ chaotic new skills that bring unpredictable and devastating power to your builds.
[/p][/*][*][p] 💥 New opportunities for creative synergy and mind-bending strategies.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Excited? Throw the Chaos Pack on your wishlist to be notified at launch and support future content!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3709260/Stolen_Realm_Chaos_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]
[/p][h3]🏆 Free Update – Achievements & More![/h3][p]Releasing for all players on June 18th:

[/p][list][*][p] ⭐ 50+ epic achievements across Campaign and Roguelike Modes — challenge yourself and show off your mastery![/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]🎲 New Roguelike Difficulty – Test your tactical prowess with a brand-new, challenging difficulty level in Roguelike Mode, offering tougher enemies and greater rewards.[/p][p][/p][/*][*][p]🧙‍♂️ Four New Roguelike Avatars – Expand your strategic options with four unique avatars in Roguelike Mode, each bringing distinct abilities and playstyles to your adventures.
[/p][/*][*][p] ⚖️ Complete rebalancing of spells and abilities to scale with weapon damage, enabling greater build diversity and freedom.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🛡️ Introducing Divine Resistance to defend against shadow and holy damage — plus expanded resistances throughout to empower tanky builds.
[/p][/*][*][p] 🐛 Tons of bug fixes and performance improvements to make your journey smoother and more satisfying.
[/p][/*][/list][p]
Mark your calendars for June 18th — when Chaos descends and the Realms evolve.

Until then…

Add Chaos Pack to your Wishlist!
[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3709260/Stolen_Realm_Chaos_Pack/"][/dynamiclink]

Stay chaotic,
Burst2Flame Games[/p]
